title: Hash Service State
description: Computes a cryptographic hash of any pipeline value using the Web Crypto API. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/hash)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

encoding.description: Output encoding for the hash digest

finalize.description: **Progressive mode only** — when true, computes and emits the hash over all buffered chunks via app.next()
